original: The democratization of data is a real phenomenon, but building a sustainable data democracy means truly giving power to the people. The alternative is just a shift of power from traditional data analysts within IT departments to a new generation of data scientists and app developers.
sampled:
I can’t say that I’m excited by this trend, because it’s hard to argue that those in power over the traditional data scientists are not those in power over the traditional app developers. I don’t mean to dismiss the role of developers at all – we need them just as much as we need data scientists. But the two functions are not interchangeable.

So how do we achieve data democratization, or as I prefer to call it – data democratization 2.0? We start by talking about data as a human right. The idea of the right to data has been around since the first internet protests, but it’s taken some time for it to mature. The idea of data as a human right is a central tenet of digital rights activists, and it’s a good place to start when talking about data democratization. Right now companies with access to large datasets of customer information don’t need to think about who those datasets should belong to. They have no legal obligation to provide access to all of those data sets. The data belongs to the company that owns the data. The data belongs to the consumer. The data belongs to society. The data belongs to all of us. The data belongs to everyone.

The right to data isn’t just an idealistic pipe dream. The idea of the right to data was enshrined in the UN’s Universal Declaration of Human Rights in 1948.

sampled:

Many premises have been converted into non-profit cultural institutions after they were handed over to associations by a law passed in 1999 to help preserve France’s architectural and historical heritage.

The cause is not fully known but may be related to:

Genetic inheritance

Environment

Both may contribute to one another

Let’s take a look at each disorder and see where they overlap.

Attention Deficit Hyperactivity Disorder (ADHD)

Symptoms

Symptoms of ADHD typically include a lack of focus, lack of motivation, lack of persistence, impulsive behavior, and difficulty organizing or following through with tasks.

Causes

ADHD is thought to be caused by a combination of genetic factors and environmental factors. However, scientists are still learning the role genetics plays in ADHD. The environmental factors are a result of the way the brain is wired. The brain is wired to focus the majority of the time, which means if an environment is not supporting this process, ADHD can result. For example, children who are exposed to excessive noise or light are more likely to struggle with ADHD. If the child struggles, the environment needs to be modified to help support the child’s brain.

Diagnosis

Diagnosis of ADHD may be difficult. The diagnosis must be made by a licensed mental health care provider. The diagnosis must also be supported with documentation of the symptoms and signs of the disorder

s older brother, drummer Andrew – have come a long way since the quartet �first met at Brown’s high school, where they’d listen to everyone from the Smiths to the Pixies, and where their live shows were more likely to include a visit from the local authorities than an endearing post-punk charm. The band’s last few albums have been marked by a confident and sardonic sense of humor, which only continues to grow on The New Abnormal . While the group have always excelled at crafting catchy melodies that manage to be both accessible and distinctly indie-rock, their latest tracks are far more experimental than any they’d ever recorded.

Not that the record feels particularly raw or unpolished. The New Abnormal sounds as sleek as anything they’ve ever made, with its clear but uncluttered arrangements, its lush underbrush of synths, its tight, well-honed playing and its warm, enveloping vocals. � It’s hard to believe, but it’s been more than five years since the last Parquet Courts record, 2012’s critically acclaimed We Are Young . Savage, who has made a name for himself on the solo circuit – with 2015’s Sun Giant in particular standing as a benchmark for his work as a poet – has said that the band’s hiatus was largely the result of the demands the solo artist put on his bandmates.
